description: Nexora Table is an Arabic-first advanced data table for Power BI, built with full right-to-left (RTL) support. It turns a plain list of records into something you can actually read: in-cell heatmaps and progress bars surface the highs and lows, a per-row sparkline shows the trend, and the first column stays pinned while you scroll. Key features: - In-cell heatmap with configurable min/max colors, and in-cell progress bars. - Sparkline column showing a mini trend per row. - Pinned first column, alternating rows, configurable gridlines, and optional dividers between header columns. - Built-in search, row selection and cross-filtering to the rest of the page — with a customizable selection color and a subtle selection animation. - Per-column number formatting: number, percent and currency — including the official Saudi Riyal symbol (U+20C1). - Conditional coloring by thresholds you define. - Smart row cap up to 30,000 rows with a clear status indicator. - Arabic/English localization, RTL/LTR/Auto direction, and full font control. Everything runs inside your report: no external services, no network calls, no telemetry your data never leaves Power BI. Ideal for: detailed financial and operational reports, side-by-side record comparison, HR and sales tables, and any large table that needs search and quick scanning. A full 30-day trial is included.
